contractRules.dte: Prefer 18–30 months; at least 12–24+ when liquidity dictates.
contractRules.selection: Among eligible ITM contracts with comparable current data, apply the acceptable-spread gate, then highest OI wins; tightest relative spread breaks ties.
contractRules.iv: Verify live IV against the stock’s regime and event risk; avoid panic-volatility overpayment.
contractRules.fundamentalTarget: Strike below conservative Bear value and materially below Base; expiration-specific scenarios.
contractRules.management: 30/30/40 allocation follows underlying support and thesis, not option losses.
contractRules.missingData: No verified winner without current bid/ask, delta, IV and OI; no invented values.
